question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Scatered"** is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling is** "Scattered"**. (बिखरा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example:** The papers were **scattered** all over the floor.
 
 
 
• **"Scattered"** means spread or thrown over a large area. (बिखरा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** The leaves were **scattered **by the wind.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Crowded** (भीड़भाड़): Full of people, leaving little or no room for movement.

 
 
• **Example:** The subway was so **crowded** that I could hardly move.
 
 
 
• **Imprudent** (अविवेकी): Not showing care for the consequences of an action; rash.
 
 
• **Example:** It was **imprudent **of him to invest all his money in one stock.
 
 
 
• **Brazen** (बेशर्म): Bold and without shame.
 
 
• **Example:** His **brazen** disregard for the rules shocked everyone.
